title: Business Analyst Planning & Cost Allocation
full_description:
Makati City, Philippines
Business Analyst Planning & Cost Allocation |COO Finance | Tribe Management Accounting & Cost Management
Background on what ING is about:
ING Hubs Philippines (ING Hubs PH) is an international part of the ING organization delivering services to many Business Units across the world for both Wholesale Banking and Retail Banking activities. Working for ING Hubs PH means working with the most diverse workforce and where no challenge is the same.
At ING our purpose is to empower people to stay a step ahead in life and business. We believe that sustainable progress is driven by people with the imagination and determination to make a better future for themselves and those around them.
ING is changing what banking is. For you, that means plenty of opportunities for personal growth in a continuously evolving environment. If this is the environment you thrive in, then apply and join us in changing the future of banking!
We are looking for a Business Analyst to lead and support change management initiatives within Tribe Management Accounting utilizing Oracle EPM Cloud. Based in the Philippines, this role within COO Finance supports group finance and other global finance stakeholders across regions, ensuring seamless delivery of change initiatives and continuous improvement of ING’s global management accounting system.
Key Responsibilities:
Global Change Management: Support EPM related change initiatives EPM cloud in alignment with the Global Finance Strategy.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with finance leads and teams to gather requirements, manage expectations, and deliver value.
Business Analysis: Translate business needs into functional and technical requirements for Oracle EPM modules (Cost Allocations, Planning, FCCS, Reporting).
Solution Delivery: Work closely with developers to ensure successful implementation and adoption of EPM enhancements and onboardings of entities.
Testing & Training: perform functional testing, drive UAT, develop training materials, and support global user onboarding and change adoption.
Continuous Improvement: Identify and recommend improvements in way of working.
Required Qualifications & Experience:
2 to 5 years of experience as a business analyst with experience in EPM cloud is a plus
Experience in global change management, software implementations and stakeholder engagement across multiple regions.
Good understanding of management accounting and/or financial planning & advice and financial and management reporting in a banking or financial services context.
Experience working in Agile environments, preferably in a Tribe/Squad model.
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones.
Familiarity with tools such as Smart View, SQL, Oracle Data Management, and Oracle Analytics Cloud is a plus.
Certifications in Oracle EPM, Change Management or Business analysis are advantageous.
Strategic and analytical thinking
Strong interpersonal and facilitation skills
Proactive and self-driven
Comfortable working independently and remotely
Culturally aware and globally minded
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society.
